name: Git Toolbox
description: A full Git panel for Orca: commit graph with branch labels, branch tree with incoming and outgoing counts, commit details and diffs, staging and commits, side-by-side merge conflict resolution, a project and worktree switcher, a status bar branch indicator and background fetch.

cover.alt: Git Toolbox panel showing a commit graph with coloured lanes, a branch tree and commit details

screenshots.alt: Log view: branch tree, commit graph with branch labels, and the selected commit with its changed files
screenshots.caption: Commit graph, branch tree and commit details

screenshots.alt: Changes view: staged, changed and new files, a diff of a staged file and the commit message box
screenshots.caption: Stage files, review diffs and commit

screenshots.alt: Merge view: your version, the editable result and their version side by side, with conflicting chunks highlighted and buttons to take either side
screenshots.caption: Resolve conflicts chunk by chunk

screenshots.alt: Switcher listing worktrees grouped by project, with search
screenshots.caption: Switch projects and worktrees

screenshots.alt: Log view in a light theme
screenshots.caption: Follows your Orca theme

commands.title: Git Toolbox: Switch Project or Worktree

settings.title: Auto-fetch interval (minutes)
settings.description: Fetch all remotes of the focused repository in the background. 0 turns auto-fetch off.

settings.title: Status bar refresh (seconds)
settings.description: How often the status bar re-reads the current branch and ahead/behind counts. 0 refreshes only on workspace changes and actions.

settings.title: Notify when the branch falls behind
settings.description: After a background fetch, show a notification when the current branch has new incoming commits.
